source.top_level_missing_records: FIELD_ABSENT; per-token-group missing_records checked by summary producer
source.coverage_note: logged requests only; missing days are not zero; September 26 is partial and excluded

method.request_normalized_cycle_proxy: Sum each of six camera-stage total_tokens/completed_requests, plus cross_camera total_tokens/completed_requests multiplied by cross_camera completed requests / montrose_shoreline completed requests.
caveats: Request counts are not deduplicated retries and do not prove valid complete cycles.
Cached input is a subset of input and reasoning output is a subset of output; neither is added to total tokens.
Dollar cost is not estimated because applicable billing/tier reconciliation is absent.
Effectiveness equivalence is not established because no held-out Jubilee event/control set exists.

comparison_to_2026_09_24_audit.interpretation: The measured reduction held and improved slightly after adding September 24-25; it remains far below the 50% directional target.

coverage_cross_check.current_day_note: September 26 is partial. Scoped records show six-camera success during the central target-window candidates, but later Point Clear capture failures also occurred; current-day partial data are not counted as savings.
coverage_cross_check.six_camera_contract: Preserved in calculation; failures or missing camera stages are not credited as efficiency.

decision: Retain the deployed compact/cache behavior. The seven-day aggregate supports a stable approximately 7.9% request-normalized token reduction, but not the 50% target and not equivalent Jubilee-event detection. Do not promote cheaper vision models or further reductions without bounded effectiveness tests.
